questions_adjudicated.question: R6C-YEAR-PROVENANCE: opening a previous-year row source after connection restore
questions_adjudicated.adjudication: confirmed root P7-176: frmAccountBalance/frmAccountsStatement btnShow_Click swap connstr to the year DB, load results, then IMMEDIATELY restore connstr and clear ReturnYearPreviews (frmAccountBalance 673-687, frmAccountsStatement 844-858). BtnShowDetail_Click (frmAccountsStatement 874-891, frmAccountBalance 784-792) then calls EntryOper.ShowEntrySource(globalId) with no year swap — ConnObj() targets the CURRENT year DB; previous-year Entry GlobalId not found; dispatcher returns silently at lines 1032-1033 with no user feedback. Cross-DB GlobalId collision would open a wrong document but GlobalIds are GUID-like making collision unlikely in practice
questions_adjudicated.certainty: confirmed (static control flow; P7-115 covers the restore pattern itself, this root covers the downstream entry-source consequence)

questions_adjudicated.question: R7 branch re-hydration: Initial reads details with session branch after global-key header
questions_adjudicated.adjudication: confirmed root P7-174: FrmIntialRestraiction dispatcher case 0 loads header by GlobalId with no branch filter (EntryOper 1160), then ReadDataFromReader loads Entry_sub lines with session-branch filter 'WHERE branch={MainClass.BranchNo} AND EntryGlobalId=...' (278-281) — a cross-branch initial entry opens with its true header and EMPTY lines grid. Sibling receiver FrmNewEntry (case 10) loads lines branch-free 'where EntryGlobalId=...' Invoice receivers load Inv_Sub by InvGlobalID with no branch filter (InvoiceOper.BindingInvoice 3366-3368) — also branch-free
